text:
maria: Quick heads-up — the new quickstart sample app tries to call an SDK batch-delete for test datasets during onboarding but the Node SDK doesn't expose that method. Docs show a curl for /admin/datasets:batch_delete and sampleapp calls `sdk.datasets.batchDelete()` which throws.

tyler: Can you paste the exact error and the sampleapp line? I can try a quick patch.

maria: Error we get: ```TypeError: sdk.datasets.batchDelete is not a function    at Object.cleanup (/app/scripts/onboard.js:42:24)```

maria: sampleapp uses: `await sdk.datasets.batchDelete({ dataset_ids: ids })` and the README links to the curl example.

sam: We intentionally only implemented per-dataset admin endpoints in the SDK because batch operations felt risky without RBAC checks surfaced. But the quickstart bypassed that assumption.

olivia: Product note — onboarding should be frictionless. If docs call an SDK helper we should ship the helper or change the docs. Prefer shipping a small, vetted SDK wrapper for batch delete with explicit confirm flag.

tyler: I can add a minimal Node SDK `datasets.batchDelete` that calls POST `/admin/datasets:batch_delete` with `dataset_ids` body and confirm param. Will open a PR today. @maria can you add a tiny fallback in sampleapp to use REST until the SDK release?

maria: Yep. I'll update sampleapp to fallback to direct fetch call when `sdk.datasets.batchDelete` is undefined. Using this snippet:```js
await fetch(`${API_BASE}/admin/datasets:batch_delete`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ dataset_ids: ids, confirm: true })
})
```

jordan: I'll add a small DX checklist item: docs shouldn't reference SDK helpers that aren't GA. Also we should add an integration test that runs the quickstart against the SDK to catch parity gaps.

devex-bot: Created issue #412: "Node SDK missing admin batch-delete parity (blocks quickstart)" and assigned to @tyler. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/412 :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — deploying the sampleapp fallback patch now and will remove once the SDK PR lands.

tyler: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/589 — adds `datasets.batchDelete` + unit tests. Will request review from @sam and @jordan.
